676:t_1:7.en:

676:t_2:3.en: ～$$フロンティア船団$$　$$バトル・フロンティア$$　Bridge～

676:t_2:4.en:
$$三島$$
「...Miss $$ストライカー#pilot$$ and the $$堕天翅$$ bought us plenty of time. Thanks to them, all our preparations are complete.」

676:t_2:5.en:
$$三島$$
「Once I show them the power of this $$クイーン・フロンティア$$ and my power as its master, it will all be over.」

676:t_2:6.en:
$$三島$$
「No... It won't be over. That will be the start of a new century!」

676:t_2:9.en:
$$三島$$
「What do you want? Do you have some urgent report?」

676:t_2:11.en:
$$新統合軍兵$$
「You have outlived your usefulness.」

676:t_2:15.en:
$$新統合軍兵$$
「We have confirmed completion of the mission.」

676:t_2:19.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「...So at last, the entire $$フロンティア船団$$ is ours.」

676:t_2:20.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Heh heh... Now that it has already collapsed as a fleet, I have no interest in such a thing.」

676:t_2:21.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「But $$レオン・三島$$ was quite the fool.」

676:t_2:22.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「He outwitted $$グレイス#pilot$$ and thought he had won a total victory.」

676:t_2:23.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Right to the end, he never seemed to realize that we leaked her plan as a trap to make him let his guard down.」

676:t_2:24.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「What shall we do with $$グレイス#pilot$$?」

676:t_2:25.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「We can dispose of her. We no longer need her.」

676:t_2:26.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「She is pitiful. She worked so hard to seize the galaxy with us.」

676:t_2:27.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「She has changed. She spent far too much time with the samples.」

676:t_2:28.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「We can forget about someone who's already dead. Let's hurry to the bridge instead.」

676:t_2:29.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Yes, let's. We can finally escape this cramped place.」

676:t_2:30.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「From now on, the whole vast universe will be ours.」

676:t_2:31.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Yes... This form, with multiple consciousnesses united as one, is the new form of humanity that has attained $$シンカ$$.」

676:t_3:3.en: ～$$ギャラクシー船団$$　Opera House Dressing Room～

676:t_3:4.en:
$$シェリル$$
「...You really are a boy!」

676:t_3:6.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Y-your kabuki was wonderful. It really, really... looked like a heavenly maiden flying through the sky...!」

676:t_3:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「I was flying through the sky...?」

676:t_3:9.en:
$$矢三郎$$
「Thank you, young lady. But $$アルト$$ is still in training.」

676:t_3:12.en:
$$シェリル$$
「I'll sing someday too! I'll make the galaxy tremble with my songs, every bit as much as you!」

676:t_3:17.en:
???
「...$$シェリル$$! Hold on, $$シェリル$$!」

676:t_3:19.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I'm so glad! $$シェリル$$, you were unconscious for so long!」

676:t_3:20.en:
$$シェリル$$
「I was dreaming... about a precious memory from long ago... when I was a child...」

676:t_3:22.en:
$$シェリル$$
「...$$ランカ$$-chan... It seems something good happened to you...」

676:t_3:24.en:
$$シェリル$$
「...It's all right. I... still have my songs.」

676:t_3:26.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Come on, let's go... Our songs are needed now more than ever.」

676:t_3:29.en:
$$エルモ$$
「With $$アイランド１$$ in this state, how can you sing...?!」

676:t_3:30.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「...You... don't need to worry... about that...」

676:t_3:32.en:
$$ランカ$$
「$$グレイス#pilot$$, what happened to you...?!」

676:t_3:33.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「Sing, $$シェリル$$... I've activated... the $$フォールドアンプ$$ on the church stage...」

676:t_3:34.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Why are you helping us...?」
